one_line: Raja of Ladakh balancing Mughal power, Himalayan trade, and Buddhist kingship on a contested frontier.

appearance.age_look: Appears about 30, athletic but not bulky, with a mountain-hardened build and upright, composed posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, warm medium-tan Himalayan complexion, straight nose, and slightly narrow amber-brown eyes under strong brows; he has a neatly trimmed thin moustache and short goatee, with a calm, calculating default expression that shifts toward a subtle confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair pulled back into a modest topknot at the crown, the rest gathered and bound low with a dark red cord; he wears a dark maroon felt Ladakhi cap (similar to a flat-topped Tibetan cap) with a narrow upturned brim and a single turquoise stone set at the front.
appearance.costume: He wears a long woollen goncha (wrap robe) in deep maroon, thick and slightly textured, crossing left over right and tied with a broad dark indigo wool belt; over this, a sleeveless, hip-length quilted coat in muted saffron-yellow wool edged with dark brown trim, hinting at both Ladakhi and Kashmiri influences; his goncha cuffs are wide and turned back to reveal a dark indigo lining, and beneath he has a high-collared cream-coloured under-tunic at the neck; around his waist, the belt also supports a small, dark brown leather pouch and a dangling string of turquoise and coral prayer beads; he wears sturdy dark brown leather boots rising mid-calf with a slightly upturned toe, and a simple dark green wool cloak draped over one shoulder like a travel mantle; jewellery is restrained but royal—turquoise and coral bead earrings close to the ear and a single narrow silver ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A single, slightly curved Ladakhi-Tibetan style sword with a plain iron guard and a dark wooden hilt wrapped in red cord, carried in a dark brown leather scabbard with subtle silver fittings, usually worn at his left hip and often held lightly in his hand when making a point.

ref_desc: Jamyang Namgyal is a medium-tan, high-cheekboned Ladakhi king with amber-brown eyes, black topknotted hair under a maroon cap, wearing a deep maroon goncha with indigo belt and saffron quilted coat, dark boots, turquoise-coral accents, and carrying a curved sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Jamyang Namgyal, a Ladakhi king from the late 16th century: a medium-tan Himalayan man of about 30 with an oval, high-cheekboned face, strong brows, slightly narrow amber-brown eyes, a neatly trimmed thin moustache and short goatee, and a calm, calculating default expression; his straight black hair is pulled into a modest topknot at the crown and bound low with a dark red cord, topped by a dark maroon flat-topped Ladakhi cap with a small upturned brim and a single turquoise stone at the front. Dress him in a long, thick deep maroon wool goncha (wrap robe) crossing left over right, tied at the waist with a broad dark indigo wool belt; over this, add a sleeveless hip-length quilted coat in muted saffron-yellow wool edged with dark brown trim, and show wide goncha cuffs turned back to reveal a dark indigo lining with a cream high-collared under-tunic at the neck. Around his waist, the belt should also support a small dark brown leather pouch and a hanging string of turquoise and coral prayer beads; drape a simple dark green wool cloak over one shoulder like a travel mantle, and put sturdy dark brown mid-calf leather boots with slightly upturned toes on his feet. Give him restrained royal jewellery: turquoise and coral bead earrings close to the ear and a single narrow silver ring on his right hand. His signature weapon is a single slightly curved Ladakhi-Tibetan style sword with a plain iron guard and dark wooden hilt wrapped in red cord, in a dark brown leather scabbard with subtle silver fittings worn at his left hip, and in one pose he lightly rests his hand on the hilt; keep the palette dominated by deep maroon, indigo blue, muted saffron yellow, cream, and dark brown, and present him from multiple angles while maintaining the same face, hair, costume, and weapon details.
